sin.name: redundant-else
sin.description: An `else` after an `if` branch that already left (it returns, throws, breaks or continues): it indents the rest for nothing
sin.rule: Drop the `else` after a branch that returns, throws, continues or breaks; let the rest run at the function's own level.
sin.suggestion: Delete the `else` and dedent what was inside it; the exit above already says the rest only runs when the condition did not hold.
